steps.title: Start from Home
steps.voice: To assign a workout program, open the menu.

steps.title: Pick a Program
steps.voice: Choose Pick a Program to browse your options.

steps.title: Choose a training style
steps.voice: Choose a training style that fits your goals and schedule.

steps.title: Compare the routines
steps.voice: Compare the routines, then open Details for a closer look.

steps.title: Review the program
steps.voice: Review the experience level, training cycle, and how the program progresses.

steps.title: Assign to me
steps.voice: Tap Assign to me when you've found the right fit.

steps.title: Choose your start date
steps.voice: Choose Today, Tomorrow, or Next Monday as your start date.

steps.title: Confirm your selection
steps.voice: Tap Assign to save your start date.

steps.title: Your program is assigned
steps.voice: Already Assigned confirms your selection and prevents duplicate assignments.

steps.title: Return to Home
steps.voice: Use the back arrow to return to Home.
